Algeria
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Paris, France.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Roma
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 90 days
Citizens of Algeria who are holders of regular and Service/Official passports are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Citizens of Algeria who are holders of diplomatic passports are exempt from visa requirement for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days from the date of entry.
